name: anchor_id
label: Anchor ID
validation_error_message: Start with a letter. Use only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
help_text: Link to this with #your-id (e.g. #contact). Case-sensitive and must be unique. Use descriptive link text such as “Jump to contact”, not “click here”.

name: offset
label: Scroll offset (px)
help_text: Space above the target when scrolling. Increase this if a sticky header covers the section.
